This name resonates with the gentle and peaceful nature of Islam, emphasizing the importance of compassion and kindness in daily life. It also highlights the role of women in Islamic society, celebrating their beauty, strength, and grace.

It reminds us of the Divine Feminine, which is said to represent nurturing and comforting aspects of the Divine. By calling upon this name, individuals are encouraged to live their lives with softness, gentleness, and grace, aligning themselves spiritually with the Divine's qualities and embodying them in their daily existence.
